knownTerms.caveat: Supplier's public site states separate dropship return rules will be published; neither this nor the wholesale terms is a signed merchant return agreement. Legal exceptions and refund costs need review.

supplierServiceContradiction.supplierMainSiteClaim: FactoryPrice's newer main-site own-label dropship page states that shipments to consumers in Germany are supported via merchant-provided labels and 3 PLN handling.
supplierServiceContradiction.supplierWarehouseFaqClaim: A separate official FactoryPrice wholesale FAQ says it does not currently ship directly to final customers; further distribution is the buyer's responsibility.
supplierServiceContradiction.evidenceNote: The supplier pages may refer to different divisions or operational periods. No authorized merchant confirmation, account capability, merchant-specific dropship agreement or German carrier quote has been obtained; do not invent which wording controls.

authenticatedWholesalePrices.reason: Authenticate net prices and per-size availability without inferring stock reservation.

ownLabelGermanyCourierQuote.reason: Obtain the actual merchant-paid parcel-label rate from Poland to Germany, not the standard supplier DHL warehouse tariff.

dropshipMultiSkuPackaging.reason: Confirm whether different SKUs can share a single parcel and label.

shopifyIntegrationRecurringCost.reason: Confirm whether the Shopify stock/order workflow works at EUR 0 additional recurring cost and how tracking syncs.

dropshipMerchantReturnContract.reason: Obtain written merchant own-label dropshipping returns and defect handling terms; standard B2B seven-day text is insufficient.

consumerWithdrawalWorkflow.reason: Approve a working consumer withdrawal/refund process covering the normal 14-day statutory window and exceptions.

germanyReturnAddressAndCosts.reason: Confirm German consumer return destination, reverse shipping, goods inspection, merchant reimbursement and carrier costs.

commercialImageAndCopyRights.reason: Obtain commercially usable product photographs and accurate original material/fit information.

textileAndProductSafetyLabels.reason: Verify fibre and care labels and legally required responsible-operator/product-safety information.

finalLandingCostAndReturnEconomics.reason: Recalculate true per-item and mixed-cart costs using actual merchant quotes and plausible returns.

shopifyTestOrderAndPrivacy.reason: Verify order, tracking, merchant billing, privacy and refunds before enabling commerce.

founderWrittenRelease.reason: Require explicit separate release decision after all evidence, never auto-launch from a script.

items.blockingReason: The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case yields only €5.38 contribution per placed order before advertising and overhead; do not approve paid acquisition on this assumption.
The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case yields €7.31 contribution per placed order before advertising and overhead; require fit evidence, not just nominal unit margin.

Supplier calls the garment a summer dress with short sleeves; a 111–114 cm garment length is not midi on every person and does not by itself anchor a November capsule.

nextZeroCostAction: Prepare a structured request for exact five-SKU merchant prices, Germany prepaid-label quote, own-label returns routing, size availability, photo licences and zero-fee Shopify integration. Do not send without founder approval.
releaseRule: All global and per-item evidence must be VERIFIED, documents reviewed, and founder written release separately authorized. Scripts report readiness only; they cannot approve product sales or publish Shopify.
